name: urlDNA (URL scan search API)
tier_rationale: Small company with an identifiable operator, public API documentation (docs.urldna.io, OpenAPI at api.urldna.io/openapi.json), published plans and terms; P078 chair rationale: 'Tier community (urlDNA, urlquery are small companies)'.

reliability.justification: Third-party scanner verdicts (MALICIOUS/SAFE) of dated captures made by other users: one vote in consensus, never ground truth; results older than 30 days are historical (P078 cond 6).

urldna.description: urlDNA API key (header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'); search and existing scan results only
urldna.plan_hint: the company-owned key whose plan legal recorded as business-compatible (key_plans.urldna = 'business', P078 cond 4); free plan: 100 API requests/day

search.title: urlDNA POST /v1/search (CQL over existing scans) and GET /v1/scan/{id} (existing DONE results); no scan creation

terms.quote: veto_lift: company-owned keys (urldna, urlquery in config.KNOWN_KEYS) with terms recorded by legal (key-terms). Registry terms per source (A1 BR3): urlDNA and urlquery are key-terms (company keys, plans recorded by legal).

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P078 cond 4-5). Research C0176: keyless POST /v1/search -> 422 FastAPI 'Field required' on header authorization (observed 2026-11-25) = NEEDS_KEY; 401 invalid key; 429 {detail}; 404 unknown scan id. Search results carry no verdict: the verdict (classification.verdict MALICIOUS/SAFE) comes from GET /v1/scan/{id} of the newest DONE scans. CQL max 200 characters; pages beyond 1 are premium only. POST /v1/scan (new scan: urlDNA fetches the URL), /v1/fast-check and /v1/query* are never built (P078 cond 1, test-asserted).

notes: Owned by batch p9-G03-3 (P078 url_scanners_third_party). Search/cached-result endpoints only: no submission path exists, so the provider never fetches the investigated value because of V3LUM and nothing is published (flags false).
